title: City Council Meeting Norms and Procedures

segments.text: hello and thank you for attending
tonight's city council meeting
my name is Mary Cusick and I am the city
clerk for the city of Santa Clarita
before tonight's meeting begins let's go
over some norms and procedures for
public and written comment if you would
like to address the city council you may
express your opinion comment or concern
during the public comment portion of the
meeting during that time comments can be
made in writing or spoken orally please
complete a speaker or written comment
card to participate in the meeting
speaker and written comment cards are
available at the back of the chamber
along with copies of tonight's agenda
once filled out please turn in your
cards to me or the next available
attendant once your name is called
during the meeting please approach the
podium speak clearly into the microphone
and observe the speaking time limit you
may address the council once per meeting
during public participation on matters
within the council's jurisdiction that
are not listed on the agenda if you wish
to speak on a specific item from the
agenda you may do so when the mayor
announces the item and calls your name
if you have materials to provide to the
council please give them to me as you
approach the podium to speak
in order to be called upon speaker cards
must be turned in prior to the mayor
announcing that portion of the agenda
please be courteous to speakers who have
the floor and refrain from unsolicited
Applause comments or cheering
please remember to silence your cell
phone
electronic copies of a council meeting
agenda can be accessed at Santa hyphen
clarita.com forward slash agendas don't
forget to follow the city of Santa
Clarita on social media to view city
council meeting Recaps and to learn more
about the city check at our social media
sites by visiting Santa hyphen
clarita.com forward slash social
